autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup.byHand: the roles of each launch template's instance profile, and the service-linked and lifecycle hook roles

autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration.byHand: the roles of the instance profile it names or takes from an instance

autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup.byHand: the roles of each launch template's instance profile, and the service-linked and lifecycle hook roles

cloudformation:CreateStackSet.byHand: the administration role, named or the default one

cloudformation:UpdateStackSet.byHand: the administration role, by the StackSet's permission model

config:PutConformancePack.notRead: no member of the request names a role

config:PutOrganizationConformancePack.notRead: no member of the request names a role

config:PutRemediationConfigurations.notRead: the role is a parameter of the runbook it runs, not a member of the request

dms:CreateEndpoint.byHand: the endpoint's role and the roles of the settings structures DMS stores

dms:CreateInstanceProfile.notRead: no member of the request names a role

dms:CreateReplicationInstance.byHand: the role of the Kerberos settings

dms:ModifyEndpoint.byHand: the endpoint's role and the roles of the settings structures DMS stores

dms:ModifyInstanceProfile.notRead: no member of the request names a role

dms:ModifyReplicationInstance.byHand: the role of the Kerberos settings

ec2:AssociateIamInstanceProfile.byHand: the roles of the instance profile it names

ec2:CreateLaunchTemplate.byHand: the roles of the instance profile the template names

ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion.byHand: the roles of the instance profile the template names

ec2:ReplaceIamInstanceProfileAssociation.byHand: the roles of the instance profile it names

ec2:RequestSpotFleet.notRead: the request names its roles in EC2's own protocol, one of them as an instance profile

ec2:RequestSpotInstances.byHand: the roles of the instance profile it names

ec2:RunInstances.byHand: the roles of the instance profile it names

ecs:CreateCapacityProvider.byHand: the infrastructure role, by name or ARN

ecs:CreateDaemon.notRead: the roles are the daemon task definition's, which only a lookup finds

ecs:CreateGateway.notRead: botocore's model has no such operation

ecs:CreateService.byHand: the task definition's roles and the service's infrastructure roles

ecs:RegisterTaskDefinition.byHand: the task and task execution roles, by name or ARN

ecs:RunTask.byHand: the task definition's roles, their overrides and the volumes' infrastructure role

ecs:StartTask.byHand: the task definition's roles, their overrides and the volumes' infrastructure role

ecs:UpdateCapacityProvider.byHand: the infrastructure role, by name or ARN

ecs:UpdateDaemon.notRead: the roles are the daemon task definition's, which only a lookup finds

ecs:UpdateGateway.notRead: botocore's model has no such operation

ecs:UpdateService.byHand: the task definition's roles and the service's infrastructure roles

eks:CreateAccessEntry.byHand: the principal, for the node types alone

eks:CreateAddon.byHand: the service account role and each Pod Identity association's role

eks:CreatePodIdentityAssociation.byHand: the association's role, not its target role

eks:UpdateAddon.byHand: the service account role and each Pod Identity association's role

eks:UpdateClusterConfig.notRead: the reference passes the node role to ec2 or eks and nothing says which

eks:UpdatePodIdentityAssociation.byHand: the association's role, not its target role

elasticmapreduce:RunJobFlow.notRead: JobFlowRole names an instance profile, and the reference passes the roles to three services without saying which goes where

elasticmapreduce:UpdateStudio.notRead: no member of the request names a role

glue:GetJob.notRead: no member of the request names a role

glue:GetJobs.notRead: no member of the request names a role

iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile.byHand: the role it adds, on the ARN IAM holds it under

lambda:AddEventSource.notRead: botocore's model has no such operation

logs:CreateImportTask.notRead: the reference passes the role to cloudtrail or logs and nothing says which

logs:PutAccountPolicy.byHand: the role a subscription filter policy's document names

rds:CreateBlueGreenDeployment.notRead: no member of the request names a role

rds:CreateDBCluster.byHand: the directory, monitoring and associated roles

rds:ModifyOptionGroup.byHand: the role each option takes in its IAM_ROLE_ARN setting

rds:RestoreDBClusterFromSnapshot.byHand: the directory, monitoring and associated roles

rds:RestoreDBClusterToPointInTime.byHand: the directory, monitoring and associated roles

redshift-serverless:CreateNamespace.byHand: the namespace's roles and its default

redshift-serverless:UpdateLakehouseConfi.notRead: no member of the request names a role

redshift-serverless:UpdateNamespace.byHand: the namespace's roles and its default

redshift:ModifyLakehouseConfiguration.notRead: no member of the request names a role

s3:PutBucketReplication.notRead: the request body is XML, which PassedRoles does not read

sagemaker:CreateTransformJob.notRead: no member of the request names a role

sagemaker:ImportHubContent.notRead: no member of the request names a role

servicecatalog:CreateConstraint.byHand: a launch constraint's role, from its parameters document

servicecatalog:UpdateConstraint.byHand: a launch constraint's role, by the type the constraint holds

sns:CreatePlatformApplication.byHand: the delivery status roles among its attributes

sns:CreateTopic.byHand: the delivery status roles among its attributes

sns:SetPlatformApplicationAttributes.byHand: the delivery status roles among its attributes

sns:SetSMSAttributes.byHand: the delivery status role among its attributes

sns:SetSubscriptionAttributes.byHand: the subscription role, when it is the attribute set

sns:SetTopicAttributes.byHand: a delivery status role, when it is the attribute set

sns:Subscribe.byHand: the subscription role among its attributes

ssm:CreateDocument.notRead: no member of the request names a role

ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions.notRead: no member of the request names a role

ssm:GetAutomationExecution.notRead: no member of the request names a role

ssm:StartChangeRequestExecution.notRead: the role is a parameter of the runbook it runs, not a member of the request

ssm:UpdateDocument.notRead: no member of the request names a role

ssm:UpdateServiceSetting.notRead: a role is only ever a setting's value, which the request names by SettingId

swf:RespondDecisionTaskCompleted.byHand: the Lambda role of each decision that starts an execution, read from the attributes its decisionType names
